pages.title: Stop when the chest is full
pages.text: A Sensor Item Node compares the total number of items in its attached inventory with a chosen number. Select a comparison and an output color.$(br2)For a refill system, make a sensor on the destination turn green when its total is below your target. Require green on the source Output Node.

pages.title: Using colored conditions
pages.text: Nodes may require positive conditions to be true and negative conditions to be false. If several sensors use one color, any true sensor makes that color true.$(br2)The sensor counts $(thing)all items$() in its inventory. Use a dedicated material chest when you want a simple stock target.$(br2)These colors belong to the field; they do not select a flux type.
